lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical lines are visible; spacing is widest in the mid-torso region and narrows significantly toward the shoulder and flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the second vertical line from the front, splitting toward the dorsal ridge. A partial bifurcation is also visible on the fifth line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most three lines are highly fragmented, appearing as series of dashed segments that do not maintain continuity from the spine to the belly.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A high-density grouping of approximately 10 distinct white spots is located on the mid-to-lower haunch, anterior to the tail base.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots align horizontally across the mid-thigh, and a separate diagonal alignment of four smaller spots is visible on the upper hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a spiral lyrate path, extending laterally from the skull base at approximately a 70-degree angle before curving inward and upward.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The terminal span between horn tips is approximately 3.5 times the width of the horn base observed at the pedicle.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The distal 10-15% of the total horn length consists of high-contrast, light-tan ivory tipping.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct white chevron marking on the bridge of the snout and two prominent white spots on the lower cheek area.
